description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for a performance measurement utility called 'lazy-init-name-hash'. It includes setup, calibration, and performance tests for both single-threaded and multi-threaded execution modes, using external scripts and commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with the provided description and commands.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisite conditions for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance tests with specified descriptions and parameters.
